audit.why: Spike ladder (level 3-5 poke, level 6 ults, first item, 2+ items) matches both kits: her R is 120/100/80 and yours 120/95/70, so neither is a lane duel-ender.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rebuttal was described only as a reflect, with no cooldown and no mention that it also blocks damage outright. dosFull[2].d invented a 'fifteen-second' window. Solar Snare (E) — the 1000-range root that actually kills a dashless Ziggs — was never named. Mel's Overwhelm/Golden Eclipse execute was absent.
audit.why: Rebuttal is 38/35/33/29/26s and prevents damage as well as reflecting projectiles, so the punish window is far longer than stated and the reason to wait is bigger. Solar Snare out-ranges your Q (1000 vs 850) and roots; you have no dash, only Satchel Charge (W, 20/18/16/14/12s). Golden Eclipse hits at any distance and scales with stacked Overwhelm, so chip damage you eat in lane is stored kill pressure.
audit.corrected: Named Solar Snare and its 1000 range in spikes[0]; put the real 38s/26s Rebuttal timers into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[2].d; replaced a filler don't with the Overwhelm/R execute.

audit.whatIsWrong: The most punishable cooldown was named without a number.
audit.why: 'Count it out loud' is unusable without the count. 38s at rank 1 is a very long free window.
